experiments.title: A measured joule becomes warm water
experiments.script:
# A measured joule becomes warm water
# Expectation: 10 kJ into 100 g water should raise temperature roughly 24 K, without mass loss below boiling.
register lv3
add v1 water 100g
heat v1 10kJ
inspect v1
measure v1 thermometer
measure v1 balance
experiments.expected_result: 10 kJ into 100 g water should raise temperature roughly 24 K, without mass loss below boiling.
experiments.observed_result: 48.9117 C and 100.0000 g after the pulse; temperature rose 23.9117 K.

heat v1 10kJ
cool v1 10kJ
inspect v1
experiments.expected_result: Heating then removing the same 10 kJ should return 100 g water close to its initial temperature and mass.
experiments.observed_result: Returned to 25.0000 C with the original water inventory.
